text:
Raj K.: kicking off Bridgepoint POC sync — want to align scope, success metrics, and any obvious security/pricing blockers. customer contact: @Daniel P.

Daniel P.: thanks — we have legal + platform leads on our side. main ask: validate LLM answers for internal docs search and summarize meeting notes. timeline: 4 weeks preferred.

Amy S.: thanks. quick clarifying q: is the data going to live in their cloud (S3) or do they need VPC/on-prem?

Daniel P.: S3 for now, but they want option to move to VPC later. encryption at rest required, KMS ok.

Tess R.: noted. security checklist: need SOC2 attestation, encryption in transit+rest, key rotation policy, and an answer to the data retention question. also ask about egress restrictions and IP allowlist. can they share the vendor questionnaire?

Daniel P.: yes will share the questionnaire PDF later today.

Luis M.: for success criteria, suggest granular list:
- functional: extractive search precision >= 85% on our eval prompts (see sample set)
- latency: 95th pct < 250ms for single-shot queries (50 token gen)
- cost: pilot under $1k/month for estimated QPS (we'll map token usage)
- stability: zero critical errors over 72h soak

Raj K.: agree. add rollout criteria: canary to 5 internal users, quality signoff from product lead.

Amy S.: prompts/evals note — we'll run a prompt-suite of ~50 worst-case queries. here's a tiny example block to share with them:
```
# prompt id: brdg-001
System: You are a corporate doc assistant.
User: "Summarize the onboarding checklist for the Acme pilot in 3 bullets."
Eval: expected key terms: onboarding, SLA, contact
```

Daniel P.: good format. also curious about pricing after trial — are there fixed trial caps?

Raj K.: we typically offer a 30-day trial with usage cap configurable. For Dedicated/Pilot we can set a soft cap and alert on >80% usage. I'll send the pricing note.

Tess R.: also flag: customer requires an exportable audit log for all requests. Redwood supports token-level tracing but confirm retention window (can do 90 days with add-on).

Daniel P.: audit logs required. 90 days acceptable for pilot.

Julia O.: logistics — proposed kickoff agenda tomorrow: 1) intros + stakeholders, 2) scope & success criteria (Luis), 3) security/Qs (Tess), 4) timelines & SLAs (Raj), 5) next steps & action items. 30m slot. OK?

Daniel P.: ok for 10:30 PT tomorrow. attendees: me, engineering lead Maya, legal counsel Priya.

Luis M.: action items from this thread:
- Amy: share prompt suite template and sample evals (due EOD today)
- Tess: prepare short answers to vendor questionnaire and confirm audit log retention (due EOD)
- Raj: send pricing/trial cap note + meeting invite (due 2h)
- Daniel: upload vendor questionnaire + confirm attendee list (due EOD)

Amy S.: copying prompt-suite link: https://redwood-internal/prompt-suites/bridgepoint (will attach sample CSV in meeting invite) :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: meeting created: Bridgepoint POC Kickoff — 1728769200 (10:30 PT) — invite sent to attendees.

Daniel P.: great, see you tomorrow. one more: do you support SSO (SAML/SCIM)?

Tess R.: yes, SAML + SCIM provisioning supported for Dedicated/Private. For hosted we can integrate SAML; SCIM provisioning available on enterprise tier. I'll list options in the questionnaire answers.

Raj K.: perfect. I'll follow up in invite with an explicit checklist for the 30m so we stay on time. thanks everyone :)
